# WorkRise Network

> > WorkRise Network provides data-driven research and solutions to advance worker economic mobility, worker voice, and equitable job quality across sectors.

WorkRise Network is a collaborative research initiative that combines evidence from leading institutions like the Urban Institute, Columbia University, and Princeton University to inform policy and practice around worker welfare, labor organizing, employee ownership, and economic equity. The network focuses on vulnerable worker populations including healthcare workers, domestic workers, low-wage workers, and communities of color seeking to build wealth through business ownership and union representation.

## Key Topics

- labor organizing
- employee ownership
- worker economic mobility
- healthcare workers
- care workers
- low-wage workers
- worker voice and advocacy
- Black communities and wealth building
- paid leave and worker benefits
- economic equity
- research evidence
- job quality standards
- union impact
- childcare subsidies
- domestic worker protections

## Research Projects

- [The Effects of Labor Organizing on Worker Welfare and Service Quality in the Healthcare Sector](https://workrisenetwork.org/projects/effects-labor-organizing-worker-welfare-and-service-quality-healthcare-sector): Columbia Lab research on labor organizing's impact on healthcare worker welfare
- [Do Labor Unions Improve Working Conditions for Health Care Workers?](https://workrisenetwork.org/projects/do-labor-unions-improve-working-conditions-health-care-workers): Research on unionization's role in improving healthcare worker wages and conditions
- [Measuring Domestic Worker Voice](https://workrisenetwork.org/projects/measuring-domestic-worker-voice): NDWA survey of 200,000 domestic workers to improve labor protections and worker voice
- [Impacts of Extending Child Care Subsidies to Parents in Education and Training](https://workrisenetwork.org/projects/impacts-extending-child-care-subsidies-parents-education-and-training): Urban Institute microsimulation of childcare subsidy expansion effects on parents

## Reports & Policy Briefs

- [Maximizing Impact for Black Communities Through Employee-Owned Firms](https://workrisenetwork.org/report/maximizing-impact-black-communities-through-employee-owned-firms): Research on employee ownership's impact on Black wealth building and business sustainability
- [Evidence Two Florida Counties Need to Create Good Jobs through Procurement](https://workrisenetwork.org/brief/evidence-two-florida-counties-need-create-good-jobs-through-procurement): Policy brief on job quality standards in public procurement for Florida counties

## Curated Research & Resources

- [AI and Older Workers](https://workrisenetwork.org/curated-research/ai-and-older-workers): Urban Institute analysis of AI's impact on older workers and skills development

- [WorkRise Network Home](https://workrisenetwork.org): WorkRise homepage showcasing data-driven solutions for worker economic mobility
